compact_nonliteral_operations.value: Definition: the climbing image has no spring force. The remaining interior images retain the ordinary force. Thus iterations $k=0,\ldots,n_{\rm climb}-1$ use ordinary forces and the first climbing force is evaluated at iteration $k=n_{\rm climb}$. At each iteration report the maximum force norm and spacing residual $\max_i|\|\Delta_i^+\|_2-\|\Delta_i^-\|_2|$. Stop with `tolerances-met` only if both are within their declared tolerances. If a tolerance fails and $k=N$, return `budget-exhausted`; only when $k<N$ update every interior image by $R_i^{k+1}=R_i^k+\eta F_i^k$. Leaving $U$ returns `geometry-failure`. After a valid update set $k\leftarrow k+1$ and repeat. The tolerance check precedes the budget check, so $N=0$ still checks the initial chain and $n_{\rm climb}=N$ uses a climbing force at the final residual check (without an update if the budget is then exhausted).
